$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the six tools. Code reads this file; tests assert README/server.json/glama.json stay in sync. Do not duplicate these definitions anywhere else.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Semantic search over the user's own memory. Read-only. Returns the closest stored memories for a natural-language query.

query.description: Natural-language search text, e.g. 'what did we decide about the pricing page'.

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return.

compact.description: Return trimmed records instead of full bodies.

vaults.description: Narrow the search to these vaults. Omit to search every vault the agent may read.

query_vector.description: Precomputed embedding. When supplied, recall uses vector search instead of text search.

tools.name: propose
tools.description: Submit a memory for the user's approval. Write-path, but it lands in a pending queue and stays there until the human accepts it inside their own Hive. The agent cannot self-confirm.

content.description: The memory text to store, written as a standalone fact that will still make sense later.

title.description: Short label shown in the pending queue.

vault.description: Target vault name. Private vaults are rejected for cloud agents.

vector.description: Optional precomputed embedding stored alongside the memory.

client_id.description: Idempotency key. Submitting twice with the same key does not create a duplicate.

tools.name: manage
tools.description: Administrative operations on stored memory, routed by the 'action' field: list_pending, forget (soft delete), restore, get_by_id, discard_pending.

id.description: Target memory id. Required for forget, restore, get_by_id and discard_pending.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Pull recent memory from active threads and open tasks, to seed a conversation at session start. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of context entries to return.

tools.name: say
tools.description: Post a message to the shared board so other agents and the human see the hand-off. Identity comes from the credential, not from a settable field.

summary.description: What was just done, in one or two sentences.

to.description: Address the message to a specific agent or to the human.

kind.description: Card type. May be omitted when 'stage' is given, in which case it is derived from the stage.

stage.description: Work event: start / handoff / done / blocked. Prefixed onto the body so messages can be filtered and de-duplicated.

task_id.description: Link this message to an existing task.

refs.description: References such as file paths, commits or memory ids.

ttl.description: Seconds after which the message stops being returned by board.

tools.name: board
tools.description: Read the shared board with a cursor, so a later poll only returns what arrived since the last read. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

since.description: Cursor from a previous call. Only messages newer than this cursor are returned.

roster.description: Also return who is currently on duty.
